ChancePerTierComment:
Chance for durability refund per additional tier above targeted block tier, in percentage (default: 10%)
ex. bronze pickaxe (tier 3) vs stone block (tier 2): (3 - 2) x chancePerTier = final refund chance
PlaySoundOnRefundComment: Whether to play a 'ding' sound on successful durability refund (default: true)
EnablePrimitiveRefundComment: Whether to enable refunds for primitive materials (default: true)
EnableSoftMetalRefundComment: Whether to enable refunds for soft metals (default: true)
EnableBronzeRefundComment: Whether to enable refunds for bronze alloys (default: true)
EnableIronRefundComment: Whether to enable refunds for iron metals (default: true)
EnableSteelRefundComment: Whether to enable refunds for steel (default: true)
